error: Circle with "!" (missing batch number). Use with the error role.
stop_circle: Circle with a rounded stop square. Filled: the square is a hole.
symptoms: Unwell face: eyes and a frown (sick / mood_bad).
chronic: Infinity loop = long-lasting, ongoing condition. Filled: both lobes solid.
history: Counter-clockwise arrow round clock hands: the mirror of the shared refresh arrow.
file_pdf: Shared document + a "P" letter in the badge position.
file_word: Shared document + a "W" letter in the badge position.
lab_profile: Shared document + a small test tube in the badge position = lab record.
note: Sticky note: square with the bottom-right corner folded, two lines. New STICKY base.
clinical_notes: Sticky note with a medical cross.
edit_note: Three text lines with a 45° pencil (same construction as the Animals edit pen).
prescription: Shared clipboard (one line) + a capsule in the badge position.
medical_record: Shared folder (Shared batch) with a medical cross.
animal_batch: Shared stacked sheets with list lines = a batch of records (like the old icon).
event_repeat: Shared calendar + small circular arrow (follow-up / repeat).
event_note: Shared calendar with two text lines (visit type).
medication: Medicine bottle (cap + body) with a cross. New BOTTLE base.
controlled_substance: Medicine bottle + padlock (the Animals lock glyph) = controlled.
pill: 45° capsule with a divider. New PILL base.
vaccine: Syringe at 45°: needle, barrel, flange, plunger, handle. New SYRINGE base.
deworming: No-entry circle over a worm: anti-parasite treatment. Filled keeps the ring (like block).
skip: Skip next: 45° triangle + bar. Skipped state: filled, error role.
route: Route: start and end points joined by an S path.
urgent: Flame: exactly the Pharmacy emergency flame (same idea: urgent).
home_health: House with a cross = hospital. New HOUSE base.
hospital_transfer: Shared local_hospital building (cross, door) + arrow badge = transfer to hospital.
lab_request: Flask with a liquid level (science). Filled: liquid solid, headspace open (like lab_sample).
lab_microscope: Microscope: exactly the necropsy microscope geometry (Notifications batch).
monitor_weight: Scale: square platform with a dial and needle.
wb_twilight: Half sun rising on the horizon (morning dose).
repeat: Repeat loop: two arrows round a rectangle (alternate-day dosing).
add_a_photo: Camera + add badge (photo proof of dose).
print: Printer: paper in, body, printed sheet out.
warning: Rounded warning triangle with "!". New WARNING base.
animal: Paw: four toe dots and a pad. New PAW base.
